messages:
lucy_cs: FYI — onboarding for Skylark Co stopped on staging. Their browser integration shows 401s then a handful of 429s when the app retried. They just switched to our browser SDK and ephemeral tokens.

dev_mike: can you drop the exact client console errors and which scopes the token has? also region?

lucy_cs: Paste from the customer: `401 Unauthorized - invalid_scope` followed by `429 Too Many Requests` after a retry loop. Region: eu-central-1. Token scope claimed: `inference:generate`.

nate_se: quick hypotheses: 1) client actually calling an endpoint not covered by scope 2) token minted with wrong claims (clock skew/issuer) 3) client-side lib doing hidden probes -> causes bursts -> 429.

dev_mike: @tim_ops can you introspect token id `ak_sky_001` and check edge logs for that tenant around 2026-04-05T09:12Z?

tim_ops: pulling traces now. Introspection shows token lacked `embeddings` scope and server logs show requests to `/v1/embeddings` from the same session. Also a short spike ~95 reqs/min at 09:12:16Z which triggered the eu-central rate limiter and returned several 429s.

lucy_cs: customer insists they only call the chat API. Could a 3rd-party bundle be firing probes?

nate_se: yes — analytics/monitoring SDKs sometimes probe endpoints. Ask them to grep their build for `/v1/embeddings` or provide a HAR capture. Also check if our browser SDK version has an auto-probe (we shipped a telemetry ping in v1.2.0 but patched it in v1.3.2).

dev_mike: send them a short repro snippet to run and grep for embed calls. Example: ```
// run in console
fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: "probe" })
}).then(r => console.log(r.status)).catch(e => console.error(e));
```

tim_ops: infra note: we tightened the burst_window in eu-central to 8s last month. That makes brief probe bursts + immediate retries very likely to hit 429. I can temporarily relax the window or add a short whitelist for their account while they finish onboarding.

lucy_cs: asked Skylark for HAR + the output of `grep -R "/v1/embeddings" .` and their bundle version. I also told them to disable retries for 10 minutes while we debug.

nate_se: mitigation guidance to customer: 1) disable aggressive retries (add jitter/backoff) 2) if embeddings are needed, request `embeddings` scope on the token exchange 3) upgrade to browser SDK v1.3.2 (suppresses auto telemetry probes) or pin to earlier behavior if needed.

lucy_cs: Skylark replied — turned out an analytics vendor was firing an embeddings probe on page load. They disabled that vendor probe and re-ran the flow 1: no more 401s and the flow completed.

dev_mike: great. follow-ups: 1) @tim_ops keep temporary relaxation in place for 24h and revert after 48h if no more issues 2) @lucy_cs ask customer to confirm bundle version and push an onboarding note to add to CS playbook 3) @nate_se flag SDK docs to highlight hidden probes and token scope mapping.

tim_ops: applied a temporary policy tweak: increased burst_window to 25s for tenant `acct_skylark` at 2026-04-05T10:05:00Z. Will auto-revert in 48h.

infra-bot: Policy change: burst_window updated for acct_skylark by tim_ops at 2026-04-05T10:05:00Z.

lucy_cs: marking as resolved from customer side; leaving follow-up task in onboarding tracker to add a one-pager on token scopes + vendor probes. Flagging as minor renewal-risk mitigated. :white_check_mark:
